data.name: SiteMetaDescriptionDefault
data.value: Free, personalized career test and roadmap for new graduates. Pick your department, discover your interests and level, and start your career path step by step.

data.name: AboutIntro
data.value: MezunBurada was built so new graduates can get a free, personalized answer to "what should I do now?"

data.name: AboutMissionText
data.value: To give every graduate a fair start toward a career path suited to their own potential, regardless of their family's means or who they know. Career guidance shouldn't be a privilege — it should be a right everyone can reach.

data.name: AboutHowItWorksText
data.value: We start with a short interest and level test. At the end, we build you a personal roadmap: which topics to learn and in what order, which resources to study from, and how to prove those skills with a small project idea.

data.name: AboutSocialImpactText
data.value: MezunBurada was founded for social good, is completely free, and will stay free. Our goal isn't profit — it's making sure every graduate gets an equal starting chance.

data.name: GeneralFaqPageSubtitle
data.value: Have a question? If you can't find the answer below, you can reach us by sharing your experience.

data.name: GeneralFaq1Answer
data.value: Yes. The entire platform is free and will stay free — taking the test, seeing your roadmap, and saving your progress.

data.name: GeneralFaq2Question
data.value: What happens to my data, who is it shared with?

data.name: GeneralFaq2Answer
data.value: Your data is only used to give you a personalized roadmap; it's never shared with or sold to third parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.

data.name: GeneralFaq3Question
data.value: How long does the test take?

data.name: GeneralFaq3Answer
data.value: About 5-10 minutes on average — a short interest test followed by a slightly longer level test.

data.name: GeneralFaq4Question
data.value: Do I have to create an account?

data.name: GeneralFaq4Answer
data.value: No, you can take the test without an account. But you'll need to register if you want to save your result and view it again later.

data.name: GeneralFaq5Question
data.value: Can I retake the test if I don't like my result?

data.name: GeneralFaq5Answer
data.value: Yes, you can retake the test anytime. Your most recent result shows on your panel, and your earlier results aren't lost.

data.name: GeneralFaq6Question
data.value: Why are some resources in the roadmap paid?

data.name: GeneralFaq6Answer
data.value: Most resources in your roadmap are free. Some may point to paid courses outside the platform — we recommend these because we find them high quality, not because they're required; you're free to study from whatever resource you prefer.

data.name: PrivacyIntro
data.value: At MezunBurada, we take the security of your personal data seriously under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK, Law No. 6698). This page explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and your rights.

data.name: PrivacyDataCollectedText
data.value: When you create an account, we collect your full name and email address, your test results (interest area, level, chosen department), and any experience reviews you choose to share. Your password is stored irreversibly hashed — it is never kept as plain text anywhere.

data.name: PrivacyDataUseTitle
data.value: What We Use Your Data For

data.name: PrivacyDataUseText
data.value: We only use your data to give you a personalized career roadmap, show your progress on your panel, and let you sign in to your account. We do not send marketing emails.

data.name: PrivacyDataSharingTitle
data.value: Who Your Data Is Shared With

data.name: PrivacyDataSharingText
data.value: Your data is never shared with, sold to, or rented to third parties. It may only be shared, to the extent necessary, with the technical infrastructure providers required to run the platform (such as hosting).

data.name: PrivacyDataRetentionTitle
data.value: How Long We Keep Your Data

data.name: PrivacyDataRetentionText
data.value: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active. If you want your account deleted, you can request deletion of your data by reaching us through our contact channel.

data.name: PrivacyKvkkRightsText
data.value: Under Article 11 of KVKK, you have the right to: learn whether your data is being processed, request information about it if so, learn the purpose of processing and whether it's used accordingly, know the third parties your data is transferred to in or outside the country, request correction if processed incompletely or incorrectly, request deletion or destruction, and request that these actions be notified to relevant third parties.

data.name: PrivacyContactText
data.value: You can reach us through our contact page to exercise these rights.

data.name: TermsIntro
data.value: This page explains the rules and mutual responsibilities that apply when using MezunBurada. By registering or using the platform, you accept these terms.

data.name: TermsServiceDescriptionText
data.value: MezunBurada is a platform offering new graduates a free career test and a personalized roadmap. The suggestions provided are general guidance and do not replace professional career counseling.

data.name: TermsUserResponsibilitiesText

data.name: TermsLiabilityText
